description: A high-risk area due to steep cliffs and strong water currents. Primary monitoring point for elephant crossings and tourist safety.
Main camping area for tourists. Frequent wildlife encounters (macaques and deer). Requires constant waste management monitoring.

location_name: Nong Pak Chi Wildlife Observation Tower
description: Strategic tower for observing large mammals like gaur and elephants. Key point for biodiversity logging.
Highest point in the park. Used for weather monitoring and radio communication relay. Often has thick fog and low visibility.

location_name: Mo Sing To Seminar Center Area
description: Central administrative hub. Monitoring focus is on traffic control and visitor information services.
